component.name: Linux Download Manager
component.summary: Download files and videos from the web

description.p: Linux Download Manager is a desktop download manager that keeps every download in one place and sorts finished files into categories automatically.

Paste a link to start a download, or install the companion Firefox and Chrome extension to capture downloads and videos straight from your browser. Video downloads are powered by yt-dlp, so you can grab clips from YouTube and many other streaming and social sites.

ul.li: Automatic categorization of finished files (Videos, Music, Documents, Compressed, Programs)
YouTube downloader with quality and audio-only options
Video capture from streaming and social sites via yt-dlp
Optional Firefox and Chrome companion extension for one-click capture
Live download speed, ETA, and disk-usage overview

screenshot.caption: Downloading a video with the YouTube downloader
Capturing a video from a streaming site

description.p: Bunkr download pages now resolve to their direct, signed CDN links automatically.
Added MPEG, MPG, M4V and FLV to the recognised video formats.
More resilient streaming: longer socket timeouts and automatic retries for throttled hosts.
Browser extensions updated to match (auto-capture of the new video formats).
